ov: مسحور (الإنجليزية: Bedazzled) هو فيلم أمريكي صدر عام 2000. بطولة برندان فريزر وإليزابيث هيرلي وفرانسيس أوكونور، الفيلم مقتبس من فيلم أمريكي صدر عام 1967 بنفس الاسم.
plotEn:
The Devil runs a computer simulation to analyze souls to determine individual weaknesses to exploit. The program settles on Elliot Richards, a sweet, geeky, over-zealous man working a dead-end job in a San Francisco computer company. He has no friends, and his co-workers avoid him. He harbours a crush on his colleague, Alison Gardner, but lacks the courage to ask her out. When Elliot finally musters the courage to approach Alison at a bar, she fails to recognize him; as his co-workers laugh at his embarrassment, Alison slips away. Frustrated, Elliot says he would give anything for her to be with him.
The Devil, in the form of a seductive, gorgeous woman, overhears him and offers to give Elliot seven wishes in exchange for his soul.
As a test, Elliot wishes for a Big Mac and a large Coke. The Devil takes him to McDonald's and places the order. Elliot has to pay for it, because the Devil left her purse in the Underworld. After taking Elliot to her office, based at a nightclub in Oakland, the Devil convinces Elliot to sign her contract, and delivers further wishes. Each wish has Elliot living them out with Alison and his co-workers in surrogate roles. However, the Devil always spoils his wishes by adding something he does not expect or want.
